purpose: Scheduling estimates from recorded QA timings only; never expected outcomes or qualification evidence. Missing timings use5seconds.
sources: Complete run on Linux (Ubuntu 24.04, 16 cores, --jobs 4 --case-workers 3), November 2026: 6845 cases, setup, call and teardown summed per case.
Earlier Windows complete-gate reports, October 2026, for cases the Linux run did not execute (1).
Cases whose IDs contain a retired product name are left out (2); they use the default.
